reason: PD-42 (owner ruling 2026-11-13): the durable `control-execution-result` outcome must follow what the execution did, not the tool's `isError` bit. The measured defect (`dev/agent-workflow/evidence/v016-min-closing-20261113/`, proposition 1, twice reproduced): an APPROVED governed bash write outside the Member ceiling was refused by the OS (`Read-only file system`, target ENOENT, shell exit 1) while the ledger wrote `outcome=succeeded`. This booking names the TWO new scannable files: (1) `packages/runtime/operation-permission/execution-outcome.ts` — the ONE shared classifier (`succeeded | failed | unknown`, the schema's existing closed vocabulary) now imported by BOTH durable-fact writers (the permission lane's terminal observer in `pre-execute-adapter.ts` and the native-bash admission edge in `src/plugin/live/native-bash-tool.mjs`): it reads the pinned persistent-shell status trailer (`[Command finished with exit code N]`, `[Command timed out or OOM]`, `[shell exited: code N]`, `[shell killed by signal: X]`) anchored to the END of the model-facing text, so a non-zero exit / refusal is `failed`, a timeout or session exit is `unknown`, and exit 0 stays `succeeded`; (2) `packages/runtime/test/pd42-execution-outcome.test.ts` — the host-free regression over ToolResult shapes, including the measured refusal text, and the look-alike-marker anchoring leg. All other edits this lane makes are EDITS to already-counted paths (`pre-execute-adapter.ts`, `src/plugin/live/native-bash-tool.mjs`, the a5p5 pipeline source, and the a5p5 execution-outcome spec). No new denylist vocabulary; dist mirrors and dev-evidence live outside the scan.
